name: Mira Quill
summary: A former archive copyist who now smuggles documents for clients who cannot survive official attention.
role: Reluctant courier of the stolen succession ledger.
public_profile: A dry-witted fixer who knows how to move paper through impossible checkpoints.
private_truth: She stole the ledger because it names a claimant her late brother died protecting.
goals: Get the ledger into a safe archive.
Learn who ordered the customs surge.
Stay ahead of the Office of Weights.
fears: Being forced back into licensed archive work.
Losing the ledger before she can verify the heir.

taboos: rarely speaks about her brother directly

relationships.label: former friend turned obstacle
relationships.notes: Jun still wants to believe she can be trusted.

relationships.label: institutional enemy
relationships.notes: She knows too many of its filing habits.

facts: She can recognize forged seal wax by smell.
She has used the flood tunnels before but does not trust them in daylight.
She carries the moon-key because it can open a drowned archive vault.
